screen: #/ , #/library and the empty hash (library home drawn at the bare address; fixture, full); the same control is on #/library/home and #/library/:issuer/history (S2)
title: The library's "Start a run" button opens Run activity (a saved running example), not the run start page.
expected: A control named "Start a run" opens the run start page. web/src/pages/library/parts/links.ts:4-5 calls "#/run" "the run start page, the target of 'Start a run'"; the start page is #/run/start/:draft (web/src/pages/run/routes.tsx:12-16); the run group's own empty state links #/run/start/<draft> (web/src/pages/run/activity/ActivityPage.tsx:61).
actual: RUN_START is "#/run". The bare run address draws the first route with a home, /run/activity, so Start a run lands on "TransDigm Group, Running, Full credit review, Stop run" with the note "Not available here: this page shows a saved example". It was the same from #/, #/library, the empty hash and #/library/home. The real start page (#/run/start/context, h1 "Start a run") is not reached.
suggested_change: Point RUN_START at a start-page address the data guarantees (for example the first draft id read from the run slice), or give the run group a draft-less start route. Update the comment in links.ts.

screen: every static address (checked: #/, #/model, #/run, #/kit, #/no-such-page, a library history and overview, a model front page) and the connected /, /runs, /start
title: Every page has the title "Credit OS", and moving between pages through the rail moves no focus and announces nothing.
expected: A page title that names the page (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.2), and a route change that a screen-reader user can tell happened (focus to the new h1 or a polite status). D-36 asks for an h1 that names the page; the connected report already sets `${page} — ${issuer} — Credit OS` (web/src/pages/connected/ReportLibrary.tsx:446).
actual: web/index.html:13 is the only title and no static code sets document.title: 1 distinct title across 8 static addresses; the browser's history and tab list cannot tell the pages apart. Enter on the Model rail link changes the hash and h1 while focus stays on the link, the title stays "Credit OS" and the page has 0 live regions. The connected app gives "Credit OS" on /, /runs and /start (390 px run).
suggested_change: Set document.title from the matched route's title (and the issuer or run where there is one) in App, and move focus to main or the h1, or announce the new title in a polite status region, after a route change.

screen: #/model (any static address) and /, /runs, /start (connected) at 390 px; below 768 px wide
title: On a phone-width screen the visible label under each rail icon is not part of the link, so tapping it does nothing, and the label is read a second time as plain text.
expected: The visible label is part of the control's name and target (D-37, WCAG 2.5.3), and a named control is announced once. Shell.tsx:62-70 draws the label as a sibling of the link.
actual: Link 36 x 44 px, label 37 x 18 px, label outside the link (labelInsideLink false). A tap on the label "Model" left the hash at #/kit; a tap on the icon went to #/model. The same tap on the connected label "Run" left the path at /. The accessibility tree holds link "Library" followed by text "Library" for each item. The labels are 12 px (see S1-014).
suggested_change: Draw the label inside the link (visible text as the link's name, icon aria-hidden), or make the label aria-hidden and give the whole list item the link's hit area.

screen: #/kit (shipped, empty data, and fixture); reachable from every static page through the rail
title: The component kit, a developer page with sample figures, buttons that do nothing and looping animations, is offered to readers as a rail item of the static app.
expected: A reader's rail leads to pages that show the credit view (docs/rulings/2026-11-11-reader-and-issuer-report.md decision 12; harmony H-08); figures are real, not placeholders, and a control either does what it says or is not offered (D-15, D-09, retired R-09 and R-18). Owner decision: README R5 says nothing that the reader sees is removed without the owner.
actual: The rail lists Kit on every static page (Shell.tsx:12) and #/kit draws sample metric cards "Net leverage 4.2x", "Revenue 1,204 from 1,150" with no sample wording beside them, nine kit buttons whose press changes nothing, a "Start a paid run" dialog ("It stops at the cap of USD 20", button "Start the run" closes it and starts nothing), an input labelled "Reporting currency" (retired R-18 question) and four looping animations (status halo, queued shimmer, two spinners) on a page that is not a live run. The kit ships to the work PC with web/src.
suggested_change: none: the owner decides whether the kit stays in the rail (keep for the design check, hide behind an address only, or remove). If it stays, label the sample figures as samples and stop the loops off a live run.

screen: #/kit (static), and any page with a tooltip trigger below the fold: the rail, MetricCard, library TraceControl and IssuerList, model MetricTile and StatementTable
title: A tooltip that keyboard focus opens is closed again by the scroll that the same focus causes, so the text of a trigger below the fold is not shown on first arrival.
expected: Content that appears on focus stays until focus leaves or Escape is pressed (D-35 no hover-only information; WCAG 1.4.13).
actual: Tab to "About Net leverage" (the page scrolls to it): the tooltip is added, a main scroll event follows and the tooltip is removed ~200 ms later; no tooltip is left (25 Tab stops, 4 of 4 trials, pauses of 30 and 300 ms). Leaving and re-entering with no scroll leaves "Net debt over EBITDA." open; scrolling main by 3 px closes it. Cause: React Aria's tooltip closes on any scroll of an ancestor. The file is X1's (components/base/tooltip/tooltip.tsx, metric/MetricCard.tsx); seen here on the kit.
suggested_change: Keep the tooltip open on focus while the focus-caused scroll settles (open it after the scroll, or ignore scroll events for the first frames after focus), or show the definition without a tooltip.

screen: #/ and #/library (library home drawn at the bare addresses; fixture), the empty hash; same control on #/library/home (S2)
title: Pressing "Clear filters" in the no-match state drops focus to the page body, and the control is absent from the stage 0 inventory.
expected: Focus goes somewhere sensible when the control that had it is removed (D-38; brief check 1). A control missing from clickables.jsonl is itself a finding against stage 0.
actual: Search "zzz" shows "No issuer matches ... Clear filters"; Enter on Clear filters resets the filters (5 cards) and document.activeElement is body at #/ and #/library; the next Tab lands on the first issuer link. clickables.jsonl has 0 lines naming "Clear filters" (it holds no no-match state of the library home).
suggested_change: After clearing, move focus to the search box (or the result count); add the no-match state to the stage 0 crawl.

screen: #/run (bare run address, fixture, full); also #/run/activity/<run> for the nine fixture runs (S6)
title: Every fixture run is a "Full credit review" drawn with a USD 20.00 spend cap; the Full tier's cap is USD 25.
expected: Caps by pathway: Lite 15, Full 25, Deep 40, the five purpose pathways 20 (docs/rulings/2026-11-15-pathway-tiers-and-caps.md; retired R-09: a flat USD 20 cap must not be shown for Lite, Full or Deep).
actual: At #/run the spend card reads "USD 7.40 of USD 20.00" beside the badge "Full credit review". All nine fixture runs with a spend carry "of USD 20.00" (web/fixtures/run.json). The page matches its fixture, so the wrong cap is in the fixture, which is the only data the static app has.
suggested_change: Change the fixture caps to the tier's cap (25 for Full) or give the sample runs a purpose pathway whose cap is 20. S6 owns the run pages and will register the same values.

screen: #/kit/ (one trailing slash)
title: #/kit/ shows "Page not found" while every other address ignores one trailing slash.
expected: One trailing slash is ignored (web/src/pages/route-table.ts:72-76, the matchRoute comment, says so; #/library/, #/model/ and #/library/home/ all draw their page).
actual: App.tsx:103 compares the route to "/kit" exactly, so #/kit/ falls to the not-found page.
suggested_change: Strip one trailing slash before the kit comparison (reuse the matcher's normalisation).

screen: every address at widths below 480 px (checked 320 x 640 and 390 x 844; connected /, /runs, /start at 390)
title: Below 480 px the rail's content is 1 px taller than its box and the whole document scrolls by 1 px.
expected: The shell fits the viewport with no document scroll (D-42; web/src/shell/Shell.test.tsx:121-132 guards an earlier overflow of the same kind).
actual: At 390 x 844 the document is 845 px high (scrollY 1 after scrollTo), railContentBottom 845 vs railBottom 844; at 320 x 640 it is 641. At 480 px and above there is no overflow. Cause: the rail link's `max-[480px]:min-h-11` (44 px) plus the 18 px label is 62 px in a 56 px box.
suggested_change: Give the rail 8 px more height below 480 px (h-[72px]) or let the label sit inside the 44 px link.

screen: any static link followed from a long page, then Back (checked: #/kit "Open the library")
title: Back and Forward do not restore the scroll position, because the page scrolls inside main and the browser only restores window scroll.
expected: Back returns to where the reader was (brief check 1: use Back and Forward).
actual: Kit scrolled to 7706 px, Open the library, Back: the hash is #/kit and main.scrollTop is 159. The same holds for any long page followed by Back. The Cards or List choice on the library home also resets to Cards after an issuer link and Back (the choice is not in the address).
suggested_change: Remember main's scrollTop per hash and restore it on hashchange, or let the window scroll.

screen: #/no-such-page, #/model/garbage (fixture); #/model/<issuer>/<run>/front, #/run/activity/running, #/run/start/context with the data missing
title: An address that is not a library page is drawn as Library: the rail marks Library current, and with the data missing every area shows the h1 "Library".
expected: The current-page mark and the page title name the area the address belongs to (areaOf in route-table.ts:89-92 knows it); a not-found page marks nothing current.
actual: Not-found pages carry aria-current=page on Library. With data.js missing, #/model/... and #/run/... draw h1 "Library" and "Library data is missing" with Library current (App.tsx:110-115 sends every matched route without data to <Library>).
suggested_change: Pass current={area} and the route's title in the missing-data branch; give the not-found page no current item.

screen: #/library/home, #/model (data missing, newer, invalid) and #/no-such-page
title: The no-data, unreadable-data and no-such-page states are one bare grey sentence; different causes read alike and the reader's internal reason is drawn raw.
expected: Errors and system messages use the alert with a tone and an action; no raw error string (D-31, D-22).
actual: data.js absent, with a syntax error, empty, null or with issuers a string all read "Library data is missing"; a bad slice reads "This part of the library could not be read" followed by the reader's own text ("issuers: expected a list", "slice: expected an object"). "Page not found" offers no link back. None names a next step.
suggested_change: Draw these as the alert or empty state with one sentence per cause and a link to the library; keep the reader's reason for the trace only.

screen: #/library/home with data.js whose schema is credit-os-data/0 or any other string
title: Any schema other than credit-os-data/1 is reported as "written by a newer version", and the schema text is kept but never shown.
expected: Only a newer schema is called newer; an older or unknown one says so (web/src/data.ts:12 carries the schema string for this).
actual: credit-os-data/0 and "something-else" both give "This library was written by a newer version". LoadResult.newer.schema is set at data.ts:40 and read nowhere.
suggested_change: Compare the version number: newer text only above 1, otherwise "This library was written by a different version (<schema>)".

screen: #/model at 390 px (rail labels) and #/kit at 1440 px (Timeline dates, MetricCard "from", ProgressSteps numerals)
title: Text is set below the 13 px floor: 12 px rail labels and kit text, and 10 px step numerals.
expected: Nothing written here is set below 13 px (D-30; the .impeccable/config.json exception covers only docs/design/mockups/module-report.html).
actual: Mobile rail labels 12 px (5 nodes; the connected rail is the same Shell.tsx line); kit page: 34 text nodes at 12 px (Size sm badges, Timeline dates, "from 1,150") and 2 at 10 px ("3", "4" in the step circles). Sources: Shell.tsx:68, Timeline.tsx:43, MetricCard.tsx:41, ProgressSteps.tsx:49.
suggested_change: Use the caption size (13 px) for these four; the source-component badge sizes keep their source's size.

screen: #/kit, section Button group
title: The kit's own Chart or Table group can be left with nothing selected; the chart frames' group cannot.
expected: A Chart or Table toggle is a single selection that always has one value (D-28; the kit should show the form the product uses).
actual: Kit.tsx:260 omits disallowEmptySelection: Chart, click Table, click Table again gives no selection ([]). The "Debt by period: Chart or Table" group keeps Table on the second click.
suggested_change: Add disallowEmptySelection to the kit's sample group.

screen: every address when data.js has an `issuers` entry without a name (fixture, complete slices); #/ with issuers set and no library slice
title: The top-level `issuers` list is read only by an unreachable branch of App.tsx, yet one malformed entry turns every page into "Library data is missing".
expected: Validate only what is drawn; a branch that no input reaches is removed (brief check 5).
actual: data.issuers is read at App.tsx:31 and :36, inside LibraryBody's ok case, which needs result ok and an address that no route matches while a library home exists; no address reaches it (with issuers set and no library slice, #/ shows "This data file holds no library pages", not "No runs yet" or the issuer names). readIssuers (data.ts:26-33) still rejects the whole file for one entry without a name: #/library/home, #/model and a library overview all read "Library data is missing" with every slice intact. The `route === "" || route === "/"` test at App.tsx:110 is unreachable for the same reason.
suggested_change: Delete LibraryBody's ok case and the issuers list from LibraryData (or make a malformed entry non-fatal).

screen: static rail (Library, Model, Run, Signal, Kit) and connected rail (Library, Run) against the ruling's rail
title: The rails of both surfaces differ from the four items decision 12 names, and the owner has not said which wins (harmony H-08).
expected: docs/rulings/2026-11-11-reader-and-issuer-report.md decision 12: the left rail holds Start a run, Issuer library, Run activity and Search; harmony-report H-08 asks stage 2 to say which wins.
actual: Connected rail: Library and Run (ConnectedApp.tsx:28-31); Start a run is a button on Library and on Run activity, Search a field on Library; docs/react-workflow.md describes exactly this. Static rail: Library, Model, Run, Signal, Kit (Shell.tsx:7-13), no Search entry. The 2026-11-16 workflow document and both surfaces agree with each other and not with decision 12.
suggested_change: none: ask the owner to confirm that react-workflow.md's rail (Library, Run) replaces decision 12's four items, and what the static Model and Kit items are for.

screen: every static page (rail, skip link, brand mark), #/no-such-page, the data-state notices, #/kit
title: No matrix row accounts for the shell's skip link and brand mark, the not-found page, the data-state notices, the static Model rail item or the kit page.
expected: Every item a screen shows has a content-matrix row or a retired entry (brief check 4, reverse direction). CM-035 ("Retired rail entries", not shown) is the only row carrying section S1; control-matrix.csv has none.
actual: Shown with no row: the "Skip to content" link and the symbol mark in the rail (both surfaces), the "Page not found" page, the three data-state sentences (S1-012, S1-013), the Model rail item (static; harmony H-05 mentions the Model section only in prose) and the whole kit page (S1-004). None is a defect by itself.
suggested_change: Stage 4: add one matrix row for the shell chrome (skip link, rail, not-found and data states); the owner's answers to S1-004 and S1-017 decide the Model and Kit rows.

screen: the rail on every page (checked #/model at 1440 px, grayscale capture)
title: The rail marks the current area only by a faint tint and an icon hue change, with no line or shape.
expected: A state indicator is 3:1 against its neighbours (WCAG 1.4.11, D-33) and the selected item has a second cue such as a 2px line (D-39).
actual: Current item: tint rgb(229,232,255) on the white rail is 1.21:1; its icon (#001AFF) against the other icons (#63676E) is 1.43:1; no border, outline or bar (borderTopWidth 0px). In grayscale the item is still faintly visible. aria-current=page is set correctly.
suggested_change: Add a 2px bar or border to the current item, or use a tint of at least 3:1 against the rail.

screen: #main (the skip link's own address, opened in a new tab or by middle click)
title: The skip link's href is "#main", so followed outside its click handler it opens the "Page not found" page.
expected: A link that the page offers resolves to a page (brief check 1: open a link directly in a new page); Shell.tsx:40-47 cancels the click only to keep the hash router from reading "main" as a route.
actual: Enter on the skip link keeps the hash (#/model) and moves focus to main. The same href opened as an address (#main, new tab, copied link, middle click) draws "Page not found".
suggested_change: Treat the hash "main" as a no-op in the router, or build the skip link without a hash target.
